scope: Read-only independent audit of focused V112 candidate evidence and source prefix. No tests/builds run by auditor; no timing/hardware qualification.

source_identity.source_prefix_scope: The focused run pins original and candidate production modules plus 24 supporting source/proof files. Native qualification remains separately responsible for assembling/re-hashing all 18 Count component aliases and requiring the full canonical result.

new_private_equivalence_assertions: Admission: compare the prepared visibility count with the original generic scalar function at GROUP_BEGIN.
Scratch: compare selected per-bank validity with the original selected-word predicate on valid AC_EXTRACT consumption.
edit_recipe_audit.admission_edit: Prepare a 16-bit visible mask on the existing predecessor edge, use the successor plane/tile key at GROUP_NEXT boundary, and replace only the GROUP_BEGIN scalar count with a balanced population count.
edit_recipe_audit.scratch_edit: Compute the existing AC record validity predicate independently for each cache bank, then select the selected bank's one-bit result in the existing AC_EXTRACT branch. State/error priority and selected payload behavior are retained.

geometry_domain_reasoning.generic_function_semantics: For each k=0..15, both scalar and mask paths use 32-bit t+k, compare with tile_count(p), and apply hidden(p,t+k). For p=0 tile_count is 5400; for p=1,2,3 it is 1350, and hidden() treats every nonzero plane identically. The implementations preserve modulo-2^32 wrap and p=3 behavior.
proof_partition: All p=0..3 and t=0..65535 are checked exhaustively, including all visibility outcomes in the low range.
For 65536 <= t <= UINT32_MAX-15, no addition wraps and every t+k is at least 65536, above every tile-count bound; all visibility bits must be zero.
For t=UINT32_MAX-15 through UINT32_MAX, all 16 wrap-tail values and all four plane values are checked explicitly.
geometry_domain_reasoning.balanced_popcount_widths: Pairs use 2 bits, quads 3 bits, octets 4 bits, and final total 5 bits, enough for exact range 0..16. All 65536 input masks pass an independent C++ popcount oracle.

predecessor_and_consumption_audit.initial_mask: On valid P-frame header completion, HEADER_CHECK captures the p0/t0 mask on the edge that enters GROUP_BEGIN; the mask is therefore valid before the first GROUP_BEGIN consume edge.
predecessor_and_consumption_audit.successor_mask: GROUP_NEXT captures the same plane/current tile for ordinary continuation, or plane+1/t0 when the current tile reaches the current plane count, matching the nonblocking state transition into GROUP_BEGIN.
predecessor_and_consumption_audit.invalid_header_or_cancel: The private mask can update while unowned; header validation rejects before the P-frame GROUP_BEGIN path, and every later valid consume is preceded by the normal HEADER_CHECK/GROUP_NEXT preparation edge. Cancel/reset/start changes no public state because the mask has no output use outside GROUP_BEGIN.
predecessor_and_consumption_audit.scratch_guard: The selected-bank predicate is consumed only when state is AC_EXTRACT and the selected cache bank is valid for the requested aligned address, preserving the original read ownership guard.
